title: Space colony sim built with AI assistance
author: mendlogames
selftext:
Sharing a new gameplay trailer for Benders In Space, a 2D space sim about mining, trade, and colony building.

The AI part of development wasn't image generation. I used an AI coding assistant to build procedural art systems instead, things like a renderer that traces ship hull data into pixel grid sprites, and a script that composes art directly from the game's own data rather than a separate art pass.

Demo is here if anyone wants to try it: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5114650/Benders\_In\_Space\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5114650/Benders_In_Space_Demo/)

Happy to talk through the workflow if anyone's curious.
